name: Hattori Ransetsu
bio: Hattori Ransetsu (1654–1707) was a poet of the Edo period and one of the ten chief disciples of Bashō, the group known as the Shō-mon jittetsu. Like the other pupils of the master, he wrote hokku, the opening verse of linked poetry, later called haiku, and he went on to leave a school of his own.

These are the seven hokku that Basil Hall Chamberlain attributes to Ransetsu in his 1902 essay on Bashō and the Japanese poetical epigram, each given as he prints it in romanised Japanese and then in his English version, with his commentary left out. The text was corrected line by line against page images of two scans of the Transactions.

poems.title: Gwanjitsu ya
poems.author: Hattori Ransetsu
poems.text:
Gwanjitsu ya
Harete suzume no
Mono-gatari

poems.title: Aye! New Year's day, with a clear sky,
poems.author: Hattori Ransetsu
poems.text:
Aye! New Year's day, with a clear sky,
And conversation among the sparrows!

poems.title: Ume ichi-rin
poems.author: Hattori Ransetsu
poems.text:
Ume ichi-rin
Ichi-rin hodo no
Atatakasa

poems.title: [Slowly] it mildens, as the plum
poems.author: Hattori Ransetsu
poems.text:
[Slowly] it mildens, as the plum
[Ventureth forth,] blossom by blossom.

poems.title: Hana ni kaze
poems.author: Hattori Ransetsu
poems.text:
Hana ni kaze
Karoku kite fuke
Sake no awa

poems.title: Come, breeze, and lightly blow upon
poems.author: Hattori Ransetsu
poems.text:
Come, breeze, and lightly blow upon
The flowers,—bubbles in the wine!

poems.title: Ki-giku shira-giku
poems.author: Hattori Ransetsu
poems.text:
Ki-giku shira-giku
Sono hoka no na wa
Naku mogana

poems.title: Yellow chrysanthemums, white chrysanthemums;—
poems.author: Hattori Ransetsu
poems.text:
Yellow chrysanthemums, white chrysanthemums;—
Would there were no more names than these!

poems.title: Kiku sakeri
poems.author: Hattori Ransetsu
poems.text:
Kiku sakeri
Chō kite asobe
Enogu-zara

poems.title: The asters bloom. Come butterflies,
poems.author: Hattori Ransetsu
poems.text:
The asters bloom. Come butterflies,
And dally o'er the colour dish!

poems.title: Behold the wild-geese wending homeward,
poems.author: Hattori Ransetsu
poems.text:
Behold the wild-geese wending homeward,
Mingled with the pilgrim bands!

poems.title: Omoshirō
poems.author: Hattori Ransetsu
poems.text:
Omoshirō
Fuji ni sujikau
Hana-no kana

poems.title: Oh! flowery moor, stretching athwart
poems.author: Hattori Ransetsu
poems.text:
Oh! flowery moor, stretching athwart
Mount Fuji's slope so pleasantly!
